content: Cloudflare zone HTTP requests Logpush dataset: ClientRequestURI is documented as 'URI requested by the client, which includes the full path and query string of the requested URL.' ClientRequestPath is 'only the path portion ... without the query string.' So any query parameter sent to a Cloudflare-fronted origin (Pages or Workers) is present in Cloudflare's edge request record. Workers Trace Events dataset is execution-metric-focused (CPUTimeMs, WallTimeMs, Outcome, Logs, Exceptions) and does not itself surface the URL as a top-level field. Cloudflare Web Analytics dimensions are Country, Host, Path, Referer, Device type, Browser, OS, Site, Bots, Navigation type - Path only, not query string, but Referer path IS available via GraphQL. Conclusion: query-string data is retained by Cloudflare at the HTTP-log layer even though CF Web Analytics does not record it.
